alias-of:aram-maacah_83>maacah_743@6c084.note: 19.6 has Syriamaachah (Aram-maacah) in a list; 19.7 has the king of Maachah. One spelling in a parallel list; the same-place link is a reading.

alias-of:baharum_153>bahurim_154@c88748.note: 11.33 names only Azmaveth the Baharumite. Bahurim is not named; equating the two rests on an identification from outside the passage.

alias-of:cun_311>berothah_179@13d490.note: 18.8 names Chun as a city of Hadarezer. Berothah is not named; equating them rests on an identification from outside the passage.

alias-of:pas-dammim_923>ephes-dammim_399.note: 11.13 names Pasdammim as the battle place. Ephes-dammim is not named; equating them rests on an identification from outside the passage.

alias-of:perez-uzza_934>perez-uzzah_935@.note: 13.11 names the place Perezuzza. The spelling Perez-uzzah is not in this passage; one place under two spellings is a reading.

alias-of:zobah-hamath_1273>zobah_1272@93.note: 18.3 names Zobah and Hamath as separate places (king of Zobah unto Hamath). Zobah-Hamath is not named; equating it with Zobah is a reading.

member-of:kore_1797>tribe-of-levi@0c0564.note: 9.19 names Shallum son of Kore as a Korahite gatekeeper; 9.18 puts the porters among the children of Levi. Kore's own tribe is not stated.

member-of:mattithiah_1974>tribe-of-levi@.note: 9.31 calls Mattithiah one of the Levites, firstborn of Shallum the Korahite.

member-of:meshelemiah_2013>tribe-of-levi.note: 9.21 has Zechariah son of Meshelemiah as a porter, and 9.18 places porters among the children of Levi. Meshelemiah's own tribe is not stated.

member-of:shallum_2520>tribe-of-levi@5b9.note: 9.17 names Shallum as chief porter; 9.18 says the porters were in the companies of the children of Levi.

parent-of:azareel_84>maasiai_1870@bec03f.note: 9.12 makes Maasiai the son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah. Azareel is not named in the verse.

parent-of:azmaveth_557>jeziel_1608@7c09a.note: 12.3 names Jeziel and Pelet as the sons of Azmaveth.

parent-of:elnaam_1176>jeribai_861@4edfa6.note: 11.46 names Jeribai and Joshaviah as the sons of Elnaam.

parent-of:hothan_1563>shama_2530@2adea7.note: 11.44 names Shama and Jehiel as the sons of Hothan the Aroerite.

parent-of:jeroham_878>joelah_1661@e64cc4.note: 12.7 names Joelah and Zebadiah as the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

parent-of:maachah_1844>ner_2181@82cd08.note: 9.35 names Jehiel's wife as Maachah; 9.36 lists Ner among Jehiel's sons. The text does not say Maachah bore Ner.

parent-of:meshullam_2036>sallu_2460@f1d9.note: 9.7 says Sallu is the son of a Meshullam who is the son of Hodaviah. Whether key 2036 is that Meshullam is not stated; possible duplicate record.

parent-of:shallum_2520>mattithiah_1973@7.note: 9.31 calls Mattithiah the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite.

parent-of:shemaah_2618>ahiezer_132@1d2e3.note: 12.3 names Ahiezer and Joash as the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite.

parent-of:shimri_2704>joha_1665@8c6580.note: 11.45 calls Joha the brother of Jediael, son of Shimri. Sonship from Shimri is inferred from brotherhood, not stated.

parent-of:the_giant_in_gath_2848>lahmi_1.note: 20.5 names Lahmi, brother of Goliath the Gittite; 20.8 says these, the giants named, were born unto the giant in Gath.

partner-of:abiel_23>maachah_1844@f2b8f6.note: 9.35 says Maachah was the wife of Jehiel, father of Gibeon (8.29 gives no name). Abiel is not named; identifying him with Jehiel is a reading.
